title: Click counter
brief: A number that starts at 0, an Increment button, and a Reset button.

title: Stopwatch
brief: Start, Stop, and Reset buttons showing elapsed seconds, updating live.

title: Tip calculator
brief: Inputs for bill amount and tip %, showing the tip and the total, updating as you type.

title: Mini to-do list
brief: A text box + Add button that appends items to a list; each item can be marked done or removed.

title: Color mixer
brief: Three sliders (R, G, B) that live-preview the mixed color and show its hex code.

title: Temperature converter
brief: Type Celsius and see Fahrenheit update live (and the reverse).

title: Dice roller
brief: A Roll button that shows a random 1-6 and keeps a short history of recent rolls.

title: Random picker
brief: A button that shows a random item from a small built-in list, never repeating the same one twice in a row.
